title: ls
description: `cpa filing ls --json` (docs/23 §3.1, §3.2): one page of rows, newest first. counts are over every recording, whatever the filters: new rows of this Mac, new rows of the other-Mac group, voice clips waiting for their capture, and segments still on the device (null when cpad is not running).

next_cursor.description: Opaque; pass it back with --cursor and the same filters for the next page. null on the last page.
